description: Updates an existing Discover saved query for a Sentry organization. If omitted, projects is sent as an empty list and the query dataset as error-events.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for updating an existing Discover saved query for an organization.

display.description: The visualization type for the saved query chart. Allowed values are: 'default', 'previous', 'top5', 'daily', 'dailytop5', 'bar'.
display.title: Display

end.description: The specific end date and time for the query's time range, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-01-31T23:59:59Z'); used if 'range' is not provided.
end.title: End

environment.description: A list of environment names to filter the query by.
environment.title: Environment

fields.description: A list of fields, functions, or equations for the query, with a maximum of 20. Each item can be: 1. A built-in key field (e.g., 'transaction'; see Sentry's properties table for event properties). 2. A tag, formatted as 'tag[tagName]' (e.g., 'tag[isEnterprise]'). 3. A function, like 'function_name(parameters,...)' (e.g., 'count_if(transaction.duration,greater,300)'; Discover groups by tags/fields when functions are used; see Sentry's query builder documentation). 4. An equation, prefixed with 'equation|' (e.g., 'equation|count_if(transaction.duration,greater,300) / count() * 100'; see Sentry's documentation on query equations).
fields.title: Fields

interval.description: The resolution of the time series for the chart (e.g., '1h', '1d', '30m').
interval.title: Interval

name.description: The new user-defined name for the saved query.
name.title: Name

orderby.description: Field to sort the query results by. Must be one of the items in the 'fields' list (excluding equations). Prefix with a hyphen '-' for descending order (e.g., '-count()').
orderby.title: Orderby

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the Sentry organization to which the saved query belongs.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

projects.description: A list of project IDs to associate with this saved query. An empty list means the query applies to all projects selected in the Sentry UI unless overridden.
projects.title: Projects

query.description: The Sentry search query string to filter results (e.g., 'error.type:ZeroDivisionError browser.name:Firefox'). Refer to Sentry's search syntax documentation for details.
query.title: Query

queryDataset.description: The dataset to query. Note: 'discover' is deprecated; use 'error-events' or 'transaction-like' instead.
queryDataset.title: Query Dataset

query_id.description: The unique identifier of the Discover saved query to be updated.
query_id.title: Query Id

range.description: The relative time range period for this saved query (e.g., '24h', '7d', '30d'); an alternative to specific 'start' and 'end' times.
range.title: Range

start.description: The specific start date and time for the query's time range, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-01-01T00:00:00Z'); used if 'range' is not provided.
start.title: Start

topEvents.description: The number of top events' timeseries to be visualized on the chart.
topEvents.title: Top Events

yAxis.description: A list of aggregate functions to be plotted on the Y-axis of the chart (e.g., 'count()', 'p95(transaction.duration)').
yAxis.title: Y Axis

inputSchema.title: UpdateSavedQueryForOrganizationRequest

name: update_saved_query_for_organization

createdBy.title: Created By

dateCreated.title: Date Created

dateUpdated.description: The timestamp when the saved query was last updated.
dateUpdated.title: Date Updated

display.description: The visualization type for the chart.
display.title: Display

end.description: The end time for the query.
end.title: End

environment.description: List of environment names associated with this query.
environment.title: Environment

fields.description: List of fields selected for the query.
fields.title: Fields

id.description: The unique identifier of the saved query.
id.title: Id

name.description: The name of the saved query.
name.title: Name

orderby.description: The field to order results by.
orderby.title: Orderby

projects.description: List of project IDs associated with this saved query.
projects.title: Projects

range.description: The time range for the query.
range.title: Range

start.description: The start time for the query.
start.title: Start

topEvents.description: Number of top events to visualize.
topEvents.title: Top Events

version.description: The version number of the saved query.
version.title: Version
